title: coding-study mock server configuration
description: One mock server's routes and scenarios, in a service project's mocks/ folder. Spec: docs/specs/service-projects.md#config-format

routes.description: In order; the first match wins

scenarios.description: Named overrides of a matched route's response; the default is no scenario

id.description: Named by a scenario's route and by the request log

path.description: Literal segments match exactly; a {name} segment matches any one non-empty segment

query.description: Listed keys must match; others are ignored

scenario.description: A field left out comes from the matched route, and a field given replaces the route's whole. A plain scenario is a sequence of one

visible.description: A scenario is hidden unless true; a dev or test stack's rendering leaves hidden ones out

route.description: The id of the one route this scenario applies to; without it, every route

sequence.description: One entry per request, in order; the last entry repeats

headers.description: Values are strings, so Retry-After is written "2"

body.description: A mapping or list is sent as JSON; a string is sent as it is, so a broken body is allowed by design

body_file.description: Relative to the configuration's own folder, and sent byte for byte

delay_ms.description: How long to wait before answering
